description: Inflammation or infection centred on hair follicles.
causes: Bacterial infection, yeast, occlusion, friction, or other follicular inflammation depending on subtype

appearance.general: Small follicular papules or pustules, often centered on hairs.

warning_signs: Rapidly spreading redness, severe pain, fever, or large abscess-like lesions require medical assessment.
prevention: Use clean shaving equipment and avoid repeated irritation.
